name: Product lockup
summary: The AhaSlides product lockup: The Splash, the AhaSlides wordmark and a product name as one brand mark, for the top-left of every AhaSlides site, microsite and app header.
highlights: The Splash, AhaSlides and the product name as one mark
Full, compact below a 480 px header, or the Splash alone
The word AhaSlides is the Logo library wordmark artwork, never typed text
The top-left brand of every AhaSlides site and app header
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-product-lockup> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. It renders The Splash and the AhaSlides wordmark from the Logo library (the wordmark is the official logo's own artwork, never typed in a font) beside the product name in live Plus Jakarta Sans, everything sized in em from one type size, so nothing can be scaled apart. Full is The Splash, the AhaSlides wordmark and the product name (400); compact drops the wordmark and sets the name in 600. With no product it matches the official AhaSlides logo file. `variant="auto"` (the default) shows full and flips to compact below 480 px: the viewport, or a header that declares `container: aha-header / inline-size`. With no `product` it renders The Splash and AhaSlides only. The accessible name is always the full lockup text. A static brand mark with no interactive state, so it carries no motion.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React and Vue pass plain string attributes. The element loads The Splash, the wordmark and Plus Jakarta Sans from the package itself (relative to its own URL), so the lockup is right even on a page that never loaded the DS font.

spec.label: Full
spec.value: The Splash · the AhaSlides wordmark (logo/ahaslides-wordmark.svg, the official logo's paths) · one normal space · product name (Plus Jakarta Sans 400)

spec.label: Compact
spec.value: The Splash · product name (600); no wordmark

spec.label: Type
spec.value: 20px reference size (1em), line height 1.3 (26px), letter spacing -0.03em (-0.6px)

spec.label: The Splash
spec.value: 1.325em high (26.5px at 20px type), centred on the capitals

spec.label: Gap
spec.value: 0.188em (3.76px) from The Splash to the wordmark or name, the official logo's gap; the wordmark capitals are 0.75em, the product name's cap height

spec.label: Colour
spec.value: the full-colour Splash, the wordmark in the logo's own ink and the name in text-default #1A1A1A on light; tone="inverse": all white (the white Splash and wordmark, text-inverse #FFFFFF) on a dark or brand-colour header

spec.label: Switch
spec.value: auto: full, compact below a 480px header; splash: The Splash only, for a slot narrower than the compact lockup (a 72px icon rail)

spec.label: Minimum
spec.value: 18px type (The Splash about 24px); a smaller size is raised to 18

spec.label: Bleed
spec.value: the box keeps 0.1em past the ink at the right, top and bottom, so a clipping parent never cuts a glyph edge or The Splash

props.name: product
props.desc: The product or site name (Docs, Games, Agent Fleet). Absent: The Splash and AhaSlides only, for a site with no approved name yet

props.name: variant
props.desc: auto shows full and flips to compact below 480px (the viewport, or a container named aha-header); splash shows The Splash alone

props.name: tone
props.desc: colour on light backgrounds; inverse is all white, on a dark or brand-colour header

props.name: size
props.desc: Type size; The Splash and the gap scale with it. Never below 18

whenToUse.when: the top-left brand of any AhaSlides site, microsite, docs site, careers or marketing-style page, and app header or nav rail
a brand appearance that is not a header: a footer, an email, a slide, a favicon

opinion.note: Never type the word AhaSlides in a font beside The Splash: it is always the wordmark artwork. Never hand-set the lockup from the logo file and a text span, never add a divider between The Splash and the words, and never scale The Splash and the text separately: one size attribute drives both. Do not invent a product name; with no approved name, leave product empty.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the full Docs lockup at the 20px reference size.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-product-lockup[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var l=cs(q('.lockup'));var s=cs(q('.splash'));return{size:l.fontSize,ink:l.color,tracking:l.letterSpacing,lineHeight:l.lineHeight,gap:l.columnGap,splashHeight:s.height,wordmark:q('.word')&&q('.word').tagName+' '+(q('.word').getAttribute('src')||'').split('/').pop(),wordmarkWidth:cs(q('.word')).width,typedWord:/AhaSlides/.test(q('.text')&&q('.text').textContent),nameWeight:cs(q('.name')).fontWeight,label:q('.lockup')&&q('.lockup').getAttribute('aria-label')};})()
